# GPU rental prices right now: H100, H200, A100 and RTX 4090 (Oct 21, 2026)

Newer H100 prices, across 7 clouds: H100 price per hour (Oct 26).

## Update, November 3, 2026: how did GPU rental prices move?

Short answer: fixed prices did not move, the marketplace did. RunPod and Lambda list the same prices as on October 21. On Vast.ai the single H100 SXM median rose from $2.20 to $2.40 an hour, while the RTX 4090 median fell from $0.55 to $0.43.

| GPU | Vast.ai median, Oct 21 | Vast.ai Nov 3 (low / median / high, offers) | RunPod Nov 3 (Community / Secure) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| H100 SXM | $2.20 | $2.15 / $2.40 / $3.00 (7) | $2.69 / $3.99 |
| H100 PCIe | $2.34 | $2.85 / $3.09 / $3.24 (3) | $1.99 / $2.89 |
| H200 | $4.02 | $3.29 / $3.29 / $5.27 (3) | $3.59 / $5.29 |
| A100 SXM4 | $0.80 | $0.40 / $0.80 / $1.55 (21) | $1.39 / $1.79 |
| A100 PCIe | $0.89 | $0.27 / $0.67 / $1.07 (12) | $1.19 / $1.79 |
| RTX 4090 | $0.55 | $0.14 / $0.43 / $0.54 (64) | $0.34 / $0.89 |

Vast.ai: same query as below (rentable, on-demand, exactly one GPU) on its public offers API, November 3, 2026 at 10:23 CET. RunPod: pricing page now marked "Updated October 28, 2026". Lambda's pricing page still lists H100 SXM at $4.29 (1x) and $3.99 (8x), H100 PCIe $3.29 and A100 $2.79 (8x 80 GB) and $1.99 (40 GB). The Ornn H100 index of executed trades settled at $3.38 on November 2, up 25.2% in a month. The full, dated table for more GPUs, including B200 and RTX 5090, is on GPU rental prices per hour.

## The original October 21 read

How much does it cost to rent an H100 per hour right now? Here are live and listed prices for four popular GPUs across three providers, all pulled on October 21, 2026, and what each one means per kilowatt.

## Where do these GPU prices come from?

- Vast.ai is a marketplace, so hosts set prices and they move all day. We queried Vast's public offer search (console.vast.ai/api/v0/bundles) at about 20:13 CEST on October 21, 2026 for rentable, on-demand offers with exactly one GPU of each model, and took the lowest, median and highest total price per hour. You can browse the same market on Vast.ai (affiliate link).
- RunPod publishes fixed on-demand prices for Community Cloud and Secure Cloud on its pricing page, marked "Updated October 8, 2026" and accessed October 21, 2026.
- Lambda publishes per-GPU hourly prices on its pricing page, accessed October 21, 2026. Prices are "plus applicable sales tax/VAT/GST" and vary with how many GPUs are in the instance.

## How much did each GPU cost per hour on October 21?

| GPU | Vast.ai (low / median / high, offers) | RunPod (Community / Secure) | Lambda |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| H100 SXM | $2.14 / $2.20 / $2.40 (3) | $2.69 / $3.99 | $4.29 (1x), $3.99 (8x) |
| H100 PCIe | $2.34 (1) | $1.99 / $2.89 | $3.29 (1x) |
| H200 | $3.43 / $4.02 / $4.61 (2) | $3.59 / $5.29 | Not listed |
| H200 NVL | $3.20 / $4.44 / $6.42 (5) | Not listed | Not listed |
| A100 SXM4 80GB | $0.44 / $0.80 / $1.41 (17) | $1.39 / $1.79 | $2.79 (8x) |
| A100 PCIe | $0.37 / $0.89 / $1.00 (10) | $1.19 / $1.79 | $1.99 (40GB) |
| RTX 4090 | $0.15 / $0.55 / $2.67 (64) | $0.34 / $0.89 | Not listed |

The number in brackets is how many single-GPU Vast offers matched. For RTX 4090 the API returned 64 offers, which may be a page limit rather than the whole market. The H100 and H200 samples are tiny, so the medians can swing a lot from one hour to the next.

A quick note on the RunPod Community and Secure prices: those come from the structured price data embedded in the same pricing page. The page's main grid shows the Secure Cloud figure by default.

## What jumps out

- Single H100s are around $2 to $4 an hour. The cheapest single H100 SXM we saw was $2.14 on Vast. RunPod Community is $2.69, Lambda's single-GPU instance is $4.29.
- H200 costs roughly 1.5x to 2x an H100 at the same provider. RunPod Community lists $3.59 vs $2.69, Secure $5.29 vs $3.99.
- A100s are cheap now. The Vast median for a single A100 SXM4 was $0.80/hr, under a third of a single H100.
- RTX 4090 spreads widely. $0.15 to $2.67 on Vast, with a $0.55 median. The high end is likely a host with unusual specs or bandwidth, so the median is the more useful figure. Hosting one yourself? See what renting out a GPU earns after power.
- Marketplace vs fixed price. Vast's medians sit below RunPod's Community prices for H100 SXM and A100, but above for RTX 4090. With samples this small, do not read too much into the H100 gap.

## What does each GPU gross per kW?

This is the joulemath angle. If you have power and are thinking about GPUs instead of ASICs, what does a kilowatt of rented GPU bring in?

Two assumptions, both ours, not sourced: about 1,000 W per data center GPU (H100, H200, A100) including its share of the server, and about 600 W per RTX 4090 including its share of the host machine. For reference, NVIDIA lists the H100 SXM at up to 700 W max TDP. We also assume the GPU is rented 70% of the hours. Change all three in the calculator.

| GPU and price | Gross per kW per day |
| --- | --- |
| H100 SXM, Vast median $2.20 | ~$36.99 |
| H100 SXM, RunPod Community $2.69 | ~$45.19 |
| H200, RunPod Community $3.59 | ~$60.31 |
| A100 SXM4, Vast median $0.80 | ~$13.47 |
| RTX 4090, Vast median $0.55 | ~$15.40 |

Compare that to Bitcoin mining at the same moment. Using the mempool.space API (BTC $84,655, difficulty 140.58 T, 3.1409 BTC average reward per block over the last 144 blocks, accessed 20:13 CEST), hashprice is about $0.0380 per TH/s per day. A kilowatt of Antminer S21 XP at Bitmain's listed 13.5 J/TH grosses about $2.82 a day before pool fees and power.

Before anyone quits mining over that gap, remember:

- These are renter prices. The host gets less after the platform's cut. We have not applied a figure for that because we do not have a sourced one.
- A GPU kilowatt costs far more hardware than an ASIC kilowatt, and it has to pay that back before the comparison means much.
- 70% utilization is a guess. Miners earn every hour the power is on. GPUs only earn when rented.
- Small Vast samples for H100 and H200 mean these per-kW figures can move a lot week to week.

## GPU rental prices in one line

Right now a single H100 rents for about $2.14 to $4.29 an hour depending on where you look, an H200 for about $3.43 to $5.29, an A100 for well under $2, and an RTX 4090 for about $0.55 at the Vast median.

Latest H100 numbers: H100 rent price and specs. How we calculate: see our methodology. All prices accessed October 21, 2026 (Vast.ai at about 20:13 CEST). Prices change constantly; this post won't. Nothing here is financial advice.
